name: Carrion Defense Works Tactical Smoke Grenade TSG-5
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Tactical Smoke Grenade TSG-5
description: A military-grade smoke grenade producing a dense, multi-spectrum obscurant cloud that blocks visual, thermal, and laser observation simultaneously. The TSG-5 generates a 20-meter smoke screen lasting 90 seconds using a combination of hexachloroethane smoke and metallic chaff that attenuates infrared and laser wavelengths. The smoke is non-toxic but extremely dense, reducing visibility to less than 1 meter within the cloud. The grenade is standard equipment for tactical retreat, casualty evacuation, and movement concealment.

specifications.toxicity: Non-toxic but respiratory irritant in concentration
specifications.wind resistance: Effective in winds up to 15 km/h

story_hooks: Six TSG-5 grenades deployed simultaneously created a 120-meter smoke screen that blinded every sensor in a corporate perimeter for 90 seconds — the breach team was inside before the smoke cleared.
A modified TSG-5 has been developed that produces smoke with embedded conductive particles — the cloud jams wireless communications in addition to blocking observation.
